turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My dog ignores me completely at the park. He comes back when he feels like it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's frustrating and can be dangerous. Recall is all about making coming back the best thing ever.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Use the really good stuff for recall only, like chicken or cheese, not his normal biscuits.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. And when he ignores me?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Don't keep repeating his name. Practise in the garden first, then on a long training lead at the park, so he can't practise ignoring you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A long lead? Like a really long one?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Five or ten metres. It gives him freedom while you can still reel him in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That sounds like a tangle waiting to happen.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It can be, so wear gloves and keep it short in busy areas. It's worth it, recall can save his life one day.
